notes.title: May 16th Update Notes
notes.content:
- Improved reliability of auto-save function in the Midnight World
- Added auto-save feature when switching maps in the Daytime Company

notes.title: May 8th Update Notes
notes.content:
Added movement speed settings for the main character (Options→ Movement Speed)
Recommended for controller and Steam Deck users to adjust according to your preference

notes.title: May 4th Update Notes 2
notes.content: - Fixed a potential softlock issue in the hostage rescue mission

notes.title: May 4th Update Notes
notes.content:
- Optimized the interaction with cars at the company's main entrance
- Fixed layer errors in certain scenes
- Fixed interaction jittering issues with NPCs after pulling hair in the company during daytime
- Fixed a bug where switching levels after activating headphones caused character sprite errors

notes.title: Update Notes – May 2
notes.content: This update includes minor changes for improved stability.

notes.title: Corporate Slaves Assemble! Wishlist for Next Fest Egg Hunt!
notes.content:
Hey wage warriors, procrastination o'clock! 🐟
Though gaming counts as "slacking", in this corporate hell simulator you're just trading one office chair for another! (jk)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44858394/42dbb09863846f6dc02167371018db559be22fa7.png[/img]

Developed solo by a 13-year AAA industry veteran with chronic overtime PTSD, "Devil Corp" serves piping hot revenge fantasy à la Hanzawa Naoki. This passion project born from rage-quitting a soul-crushing job lets you stick it to the corporate overlords - the ultimate catharsis for overworked zombies!

[h2][u][b][url=https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1MJPheKExb/]Developer's Letter video[/url][/b][/u][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44858394/26d84e0c19ea9702e7a8b29139ff0f56b374edf7.jpg[/img]

Since Next Fest kicks off today, let's make a deal fellow corporate livestock: If we hit 5K wishlists post-fest, I'll code a secret achievement AND grind through the night to deliver a waifu wallpaper pack!

Your support means everything. May these dark office comedy moments help you survive another payroll cycle. Now go smash that wishlist button before the boss notices! 🔥
